title: The Greedy Queen Pays
story: Black's queen wandered off to grab pawns and nobody guards the back rank. Slide your rook in for checkmate!

title: Punish the Pawn Grabber
story: White went hunting your b-pawn while the back door stood wide open. Deliver the famous back rank mate!

title: Queen Slides Home
story: Black grabbed the b-pawn with the queen — and left the whole eighth rank to you. March your queen in!

title: Mate Beats Material
story: White is grabbing pawns everywhere — you could win the queen, but there is something much better. Mate first!

title: Corner the Castled King
story: Black castled queenside, but the pawn shield is gone. Your queen sails down the long diagonal to the corner — mate!

title: Bait the Queen, Mate the King
story: Let the greedy queen gobble your little pawns — every snack pulls her further from home. Trade the rooks, and when the last defender leaps away, your queen slides to c8. Checkmate!
